claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: No photo shows the tank's interior, prior contents, or usage history; seller's statement is unprovable from the image alone.

risks.risk: Tank may have previously held chemicals rather than only water, risking contamination or odor
risks.proof: Close-up photo of interior walls/residue or original manufacturer/content label on the tote
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown prior-use / possible chemical residue (worst case)

risks.proof: Photo of the capacity marking plate or embossed label on the IBC frame
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest common IBC size until confirmed

risks.risk: Valve/tap may be cracked, loose, or non-sealing
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short video of the valve being opened and closed showing no leaks

risks.risk: Metal cage and pallet base condition (rust, bent bars, cracked pallet) not fully visible
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cage welds, corners, and pallet base
risks.if_unproven: priced as cage/pallet in poor condition

risks.risk: Unclear which exact tank among several in the yard is being sold
risks.proof: A photo with the seller pointing to or tagging the specific unit, matching a clear reference number
risks.if_unproven: priced only for the IBC tote tank explicitly shown in Photo 0, not any other tank in the yard

proof_requests: Close-up of the IBC's interior and any residue
Video of the valve opening/closing with no leaks
Close-up shots of the cage frame and pallet base condition
A photo confirming exactly which tank is for sale
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies an IBC tote tank, so it can be priced at worst case for unknown capacity, possible prior chemical use, and unverified valve/cage condition, pending further proof.
